expectedDeliverables: Editable composition with three text layers overlaid on the existing image.
Text layers styled with Playfair Display (or similar elegant serif) in warm white.
Headline significantly larger than kicker and footer to establish hierarchy.

actions.summary: Add kicker text 'SAMPLE / FIELD NOTES 01' in a small, elegant serif font (e.g., Playfair Display) with warm white color, positioned in the upper-left safe margin.
Add headline text 'AFTER THE LIGHT' in a large, strong serif font (e.g., Playfair Display Bold), at least 3x the size of the kicker/footer, positioned in the open sky area with top
Add footer text 'A STUDY IN BLUE HOUR' in a small serif font matching the kicker style, positioned in the lower-left safe margin.

constraints: Preserve original photo, framing, and color.
Use exactly three editable text layers.
Maintain clear size hierarchy: Headline >= 3x Kicker/Footer.
Use warm white type for all text.
deliverables: Editable composition with three text layers overlaid on the existing image.
Text layers styled with Playfair Display (or similar elegant serif) in warm white.
Headline significantly larger than kicker and footer to establish hierarchy.
expectedLayoutAndStack.outcome: An editorial travel cover design on the existing 1024x1536 image, featuring three distinct text layers with a strong visual hierarchy, preserving the original photograph's integrity.
expectedLayoutAndStack.summary: Plan to add three text layers (kicker, headline, footer) to the existing photo, ensuring legibility, hierarchy, and preservation of the original image.
